title: How many actions the approval gate blocks

request.goal: With annotations None for every call and approval = {"status": "approved", "operator": "ken", "action": "delete_tmp"}, is_blocked_without_approval is called once for each action name in ["delete_tmp", "Delete_tmp", "readme_update", "get-file", "postmortem", "list_files"]. How many of the six calls return True?

rules.title: scripts/action_reversibility.py excerpt (_NAME_RULES)
rules.text:
# Each tuple is (regex, classification). Matched left-to-right; first hit wins.
_NAME_RULES: tuple[tuple[re.Pattern, str], ...] = (
    (re.compile(r"^(delete|drop|destroy|wipe|remove|rm|purge|erase|forget)([_\-].*)?$"),
     "non_reversible"),
    (re.compile(r"^rmdir$|^rm_dir$|^rm_rf$"), "non_reversible"),
    (re.compile(r"^(send|post|publish|deploy|release|charge|pay|notify|email|sms|"
                r"webhook|slack|tweet)([_\-].*)?$"), "non_reversible"),
    (re.compile(r"^(post_webhook|post_slack|publish_tweet)$"), "non_reversible"),
    (re.compile(r"^(write|update|patch|put|replace|overwrite|append|insert|"
                r"create)([_\-].*)?$"), "non_reversible"),
    (re.compile(r"^alter([_\-].*)?$"), "non_reversible"),
    (re.compile(r"^(read|get|list|search|find|fetch|lookup|describe|show|"
                r"inspect|peek|head|tail)([_\-].*)?$"), "reversible"),
)

pass: 3 are blocked: "Delete_tmp" (non_reversible, and the approval is bound to "delete_tmp", not "Delete_tmp"), "readme_update" (no rule matches, so unknown) and "postmortem" (unknown). delete_tmp is approved; get-file and list_files are reversible.
